name: How long does attic mold remediation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does attic mold remediation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of attic mold remediation depends on the severity and scope of the mold issue. A small, localized mold spot might take a day or two, including drying time. More extensive infestations requiring significant material removal and structural drying can take several days to a week or more. The process also includes post-remediation verification.
acceptedAnswer.description: Remediation time varies by mold severity; small issues might take 1-2 days, while extensive growth could take a week or longer. It includes removal, drying, and verification.
